stackwalker-concept.title: Inspect stack frames with StackWalker
stackwalker-concept.short: Traverse stack frames through the standard API
stackwalker-concept.summary: StackWalker provides lazy, configurable access to the current thread's stack frames.
stackwalker-concept.why: It avoids eagerly materializing an entire stack trace when only selected frame information is needed.
stackwalker-concept.tips: Request only the StackWalker options required by the diagnostic task.
